note: Written by portfolio/tools/build-gallery.mjs. The sizes are read from the picture files. The sha256 value lets you check that a picture was not changed after it was made.
site: The pictures were made from the site on localhost, with the sample posts and the posts saved on this computer. No sign-in was used, because the site has none.

pictures.title: Home page, light theme, desktop
pictures.caption: The home page. Light theme, desktop.
pictures.alt: The home page of Neighbor Node. The heading reads: Ask for a hand. Offer one. Lend what you do not use. Below it are two buttons, one to open the board and one to write a post. Further down are the three kinds of posts, how it works, and a note that addresses stay private.

pictures.title: The board, light theme, desktop
pictures.caption: The board: posts from neighbors, with a filter by kind. Light theme, desktop.
pictures.alt: The board page. A heading reads The board, next to a button to write a post. Under it are filter buttons for all posts and for the three kinds of posts, and then the cards of the posts, with the sample posts marked as examples.

pictures.title: The board, Help wanted filter, light theme, desktop
pictures.caption: The board with the filter set to Help wanted. Light theme, desktop.
pictures.alt: The board page with the filter set to Help wanted. Only the posts of that kind are listed.

pictures.title: Write a post, light theme, desktop
pictures.caption: The form to write a post. It needs no account. Light theme, desktop.
pictures.alt: The page to write a post. A short note says this is an early version. The form asks for the kind of post, a title, details and an area, and ends with a button, Save my post.

pictures.title: Write a post, with the problems listed, light theme, desktop
pictures.caption: The same form after Save my post is pressed with every field empty. Light theme, desktop.
pictures.alt: The form to write a post after the Save my post button was pressed with every field empty. A box at the top says how many things there are to fix, and the fields that need a change show a message under them. Nothing was saved.

pictures.title: A sample post, light theme, desktop
pictures.caption: The page of one sample post. Light theme, desktop.
pictures.alt: The page of one sample post. It shows the kind, the status, the title, the details and the area of the post, and a form to reply to the author.

pictures.title: Post not found, light theme, desktop
pictures.caption: The page for a post that does not exist. Light theme, desktop.
pictures.alt: A page that says Post not found. It explains that the post does not exist, was taken down, or was hidden, and has a button back to the board.

pictures.title: Page not found, light theme, desktop
pictures.caption: The page for an address that does not exist. Light theme, desktop.
pictures.alt: A page that says Page not found, with a button back to the home page.

pictures.title: Architecture diagram
pictures.caption: How the parts of Neighbor Node fit together: the pages, the server actions, the rules, the store and the posts file.
pictures.alt: A diagram with boxes and arrows. The visitor's browser opens the pages in app. A form sends its data to a server action. The server action asks the rules in lib, which include the speed limits that live in memory, and the key check. The post store writes the posts file data/posts.json. A moderation script reads and changes the same file.
